questions: Extended Data Fig. 7 gives the device count (more than 60 fabricated, 11 measured, 2 with a plateau). How many cooldowns and datasets lie behind A and B, and in how many did the plateau appear?
Extended Data Fig. 7 says the 11 were kept for working gates and nine showed no plateau. What peak heights did those nine reach, and was any set aside for another reason?
Which back-gate, field-angle and tunnel-gate ranges did you measure on A and B beyond those shown, in particular above -7.65 V, where Fig. 2a ends with the plateau still in place?
What does the second-best dataset look like, on A or B or on one of the other nine devices?
Was a series resistance (lines, filters, contacts) subtracted for Figs. 1 to 4? If so, what value, and how was it calibrated?
How was the background contribution in device B estimated (Fig. 4b), and could you show the zero-bias height with and without it?
In Fig. 3a the tunnel gate is adjusted while the super-gate is swept. What compensation rule did you use, and how does the plateau look without it?
How long did the search for the settings of Fig. 1b and Fig. 2a take, and how many settings were tried before the plateau appeared?
